checks: Twelve distinct networks, three themes, legal costs and 59 immutable cargo units
Preview is pure, repeats without spending, and gives exact after-budget
Confirming a built edge twice cannot charge twice or change its revision
A stale confirmation revision cannot spend against a changed plan
Overspending is refused atomically and cash never becomes negative
Unbuilt, nonexistent, discontinuous, repeated and malformed routes are explained
Unknown or prototype-like vehicle types cannot corrupt costs or cash
Each intentional purchase creates one unique ship and respects remaining budget
Undo restores exact planning cash, ledger, roads, fleet and next ID
Selling and scrapping refund once and cannot mint money with repeated clicks
A road used by an assigned route cannot be dismantled until that route is changed
Editing a route is free, relocates only before departure, and remains undoable
Start validates complete origin/destination coverage before any turn or spending
Heavy cargo needs two slots even if a one-slot route connects its endpoints
Running and paused states freeze all planning purchases, edits and refunds
Future cargo changes place only on its release turn and never appears from nowhere
A skiff loads exactly one slot and leaves the other cargo accounted in its warehouse
A barge carries two light boxes or one two-slot heavy box without overload
Only arrival at the real destination unloads and earns the exact reward
A two-turn trip occupies the edge but pays its fare only once
Shared lanes and one-ship intersections enforce capacity with deterministic waiting
Return cargo uses the same line and all rewards are paid exactly once
Insufficient working capital naturally loses despite a connected valid route
A too-slow ordinary plan misses a deadline without modifying stock or money
Unloading on the exact deadline and final allowed turn wins before failure checks
Victory and failure settle once, never spend or reward again after the result
Pause refuses every transport step and keeps budget, ownership, queues and deadlines
Planning checkpoint restores roads, fleet, free edits, undo stack and ledger exactly
Running checkpoint replays exact in-transit cargo, future releases and money, then pauses
Bad, null, duplicate, impossible and ended records reject forged resource fields
Repeated legal build/scrap and buy/sell cycles never increase the initial money
All twelve ordinary plans conserve money/cargo at every action and replay exact results
Snapshots and caller-owned route arrays cannot mutate live plans or level supplies
fixture: Only the exact-deadline/final-turn isolated unit fixture adjusts a deadline/turn boundary. All normal-plan, bankrupted-capital, missed-deadline, replay and browser runs use ordinary build/buy/start/step commands with production stock and costs.
